name: gunna

attributes.attribute: A cattle-herding brownie of the Scottish islands.
The gunna kept cows from trampling the garden of small farms.
He went naked regardless of the weather.
Offering the gunna clothes drove him away.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The gunna was a cattle-herding brownie of the Scottish islands. This helpful sprite hung about small farms and made certain the cows did not trample the garden. He went naked despite the weather. Any attempt to offer him clothes drove the gunna away.

okr.objective: Present the gunna, a naked cattle-herding brownie of Scottish islands.
